motivation: Collected to evaluate machine learning methods for discriminating benign from malignant mammographic masses based on BI-RADS attributes and patient age.
composition: 961 instances (516 benign, 445 malignant). Features: Age (integer), Shape (1-4), Margin (1-5), Density (1-4), BI-RADS assessment (1-5, excluded in this system as non-predictive).
collection_process: Collected at the Institute of Radiology, Charité - University Medicine Berlin, between Autumn 2003 and Summer 2006. Ground truth established via needle core biopsy histopathology or at least one year of benign radiological follow-up.
preprocessing_and_cleaning: Missing values (represented as '?') imputed using statistics fitted on TRAIN splits only (median for Age, mode for categorical). BI-RADS column excluded to prevent label leakage. Severity mapped to 0 (malignant) and 1 (benign) to align with project safety conventions.
uses_and_limitations: SUITABLE ONLY for methodological research and software prototypes. NOT suitable for clinical deployment. Single-institution older dataset with small sample size and no demographic or racial diversity metadata.
maintenance_plan: Static archived academic dataset. No ongoing updates from originating institution. Local pipeline maintains cryptographic SHA-256 verification hash.
